data.summary: Some rules lift units off the battlefield and put them into Strategic Reserves; a unit moved that way is a Repositioned Unit. Whatever else the moving rule says about it, including when it may or may not come back, three further points hold. Used during the Movement phase, such a rule can pick a unit that has already moved in that phase. If a Repositioned Unit made an Advance, a Fall Back or a Disembark move earlier in a turn and is set up again in that same turn, that move still stands for the turn. Effects on it that last for a set duration or while set conditions hold keep affecting it off the battlefield, for as long as they would have lasted. Such units are spared from the end-of-battle-round-3 destruction in [Arriving from Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/arriving-from-strategic-reserves) (20.03).

otherRulesStillApply.including: when such units can and cannot arrive

rules.effects: for a specified duration or specified circumstances

detail.arrivalTiming: set by the repositioning rule; 20.02 names no battle round
